settingsFiles.description: The Claude CLI also applies these rules, on top of the lists above. A deny rule wins wherever it is set, but an ask rule does not prompt for a tool that Allowed Tools already allows. The rules are read-only here; edit them in the files.

settingsFiles.projectNote: A project's own .claude/settings.json and .claude/settings.local.json also apply to chats in that project. The Claude CLI ignores allow rules in .claude/settings.json until the folder is trusted: run Claude Code interactively there once and accept the trust dialog.

idleCloseMinutes.label: Close idle agents after
idleCloseMinutes.description: An agent with no turn, question, background command, subagent or open terminal is closed; the chat continues with the next message. 0 keeps agents open. Default {{defaultValue}}.

backgroundReminderMinutes.label: Remind about background commands after
backgroundReminderMinutes.description: When an agent has finished its turn but a background command is still running, the agent gets a short note from you after this long, then after gaps that double each time (1, 3, 7… times this value from the start). Catches a script waiting for something that will never happen. 0 turns it off. Default {{defaultValue}}.

attachmentRetentionDays.label: Keep pasted files for
attachmentRetentionDays.description: Copies of pasted images and files handed to a Windows Claude are deleted after this. Default {{defaultValue}}.

power.title: Power
power.label: Shut down when all agents finish
power.description: Once no agent has a turn, a background command or a running subagent for {{minutes}} min, the computer shuts down with a {{seconds}} s countdown. An agent waiting for your answer does not hold it back. Works once, like a sleep timer: it turns itself off after that and does not survive a server restart.
power.allFinished: All agents have finished. Shutting down in {{seconds}} s unless one starts again.
